# ghost_repository_webhook (Resource)

Manages a webhook on a Ghost repository. Ghost sends the URL a `ping` as soon as the webhook is created, and signs every delivery with `secret`. You must be an admin of the repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ghost_repository" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

resource "ghost_repository_webhook" "example" {
  repository = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  url        = "https://ci.example.com/hooks/ghost"
  events     = ["issue.opened", "issue.closed", "release.published"]

  # Recreate the webhook if the repository is replaced, which deletes its
  # webhooks.
  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [ghost_repository.example.repo_id]
  }
}

# Hand the signing secret to the receiver, e.g. as a secret in another
# provider. Verify deliveries by comparing the X-Hub-Signature-256 header with
# "sha256=" + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, body)).
output "webhook_secret" {
  value     = ghost_repository_webhook.example.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (Set of String) The events that trigger a delivery, at least one. One of `push`, `issue.opened`, `issue.edited`, `issue.closed`, `issue.reopened`, `issue.assigned`, `issue.unassigned`, `issue.labeled`, `issue.unlabeled`, `issue.commented`, `issue.comment_edited`, `issue.comment_deleted`, `pull_request.ready_for_review`, `pull_request.converted_to_draft`, `pull_request.synchronized`, `pull_request.merged`, `pull_request.reviewed`, `pull_request.review_dismissed`, `pull_request.review_commented`, `pull_request.review_requested`, `pull_request.review_request_removed`, `label.created`, `label.edited`, `label.deleted`, `release.created`, `release.published`, `release.edited`, `release.deleted`, `commit_status.created`, `star.created`, `star.deleted`, `watch.started`, `fork.created`, `repository.edited`, `repository.transferred`, `member.added`, `member.removed`. Ghost doesn't deliver `push` events yet.
- `repository` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, e.g. `ghost_repository.example.full_name`. Renaming the repository updates this in place; pointing it at a different repository forces a new webhook. Replacing the repository deletes its webhooks, so add `lifecycle { replace_triggered_by = [ghost_repository.example.repo_id] }` to recreate the webhook in the same apply.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The URL Ghost sends deliveries to, up to 2048 characters. It must be `https://` or `http://`, must not contain a username or password, and must resolve to a public address: Ghost rejects `localhost`, private and reserved addresses, and hosts that don't resolve. Ghost stores it exactly as given. Sensitive, since webhook URLs often carry a token.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether Ghost sends deliveries. Defaults to `true`. Ghost turns a webhook off by itself when the endpoint says it is gone (see `disabled_reason`); the next apply then turns it back on, unless this is `false`.
- `secret_rotation` (String) Any value. Setting or changing it replaces the secret in place (the old one stops working at once), e.g. `time_rotating.webhook.id` to rotate it on a schedule. Removing it does nothing.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the webhook was added to the repository.
- `disabled_reason` (String) Why Ghost turned the webhook off by itself, e.g. after the endpoint answered `410 Gone`. Null while it is on, or when it was turned off with `active = false`.
- `id` (String) The repository's full name and the webhook ID, `owner/slug:webhook_id`.
- `repository_id` (Number) The numeric ID of `repository`.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret Ghost signs every delivery with: the `X-Hub-Signature-256` header is `sha256=` followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body. Ghost returns it only when the webhook is created or its secret is rotated, so it is null after import until `secret_rotation` is set.
- `webhook_id` (String) The webhook's ID, e.g. `whk_…`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A webhook is imported by the repository's full name and the webhook ID,
# "owner/slug:webhook_id". Ghost never returns the secret again, so it is null
# after import until secret_rotation is set.
terraform import ghost_repository_webhook.example my-user/example:whk_abc123
```
